record.question: Which of the following is the most precise position of the CCS (Conduct) Rules regarding oral directions?
options: Oral directions are invalid unless approved by the prescribed authority
Oral directions may be acted upon, but the subordinate alone must record them later
Oral directions are to be avoided as far as possible; if unavoidable, the superior is to confirm them in writing immediately thereafter
In most cases, oral directions do not require confirmation in writing.
